يصطفون (form VIII)
# يَصْطَفُونَ (yaṣṭafūna) /jasˤ.tˤa.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
# يُصْطَفَوْنَ (yuṣṭafawna) /jusˤ.tˤa.faw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
